preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 200000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: any(c in s for c in 'ab') and any(c in t for c in 'ab')
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must contain at least one 'a' and one 'b'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if all(c == 'a' for c in s) and all(c == 'b' for c in t) else True
postconditions.description: If s consists only of 'a' and t consists only of 'b', the output must be 0.
The number of operations n must match the number of lines in the output minus one.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= len(s) and 0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= len(t) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each operation must specify valid prefix lengths for strings s and t.
